name: Can garage drywall be repaired if it has mold or mildew?

mainEntity.name: Can garage drywall be repaired if it has mold or mildew?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, garage drywall with mold or mildew can sometimes be repaired, but it depends on the extent of the growth. Small, superficial mold can often be cleaned and treated. However, if the mold has penetrated deep into the drywall, or if there's extensive growth, the affected sections must be removed and replaced to prevent recurrence and ensure a healthy environment. Addressing the moisture source is critical to prevent future mold issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor mold can be treated; extensive or deeply penetrated mold requires removal and replacement of drywall sections.
